# The setup code defines array a
# We need to compute result = ... that gives both diagonals
# The problem asks for array([[0, 6, 12, 18, 24], [4, 8, 12, 16, 20]])
# That is main diagonal and anti-diagonal (from top-right to bottom-left)
# For a general array shape (m, n), we need to get both diagonals

# Get shape
m, n = a.shape
# Main diagonal indices (top-left to bottom-right)
diag_main = np.diag(a)
# Anti-diagonal (top-right to bottom-left)
# For anti-diagonal, we need indices: row i, column n-1-i, for i from 0 to min(m,n)-1
k = min(m, n)
anti_indices = (np.arange(k), n - 1 - np.arange(k))
diag_anti = a[anti_indices]
# Combine into a 2D array
result = np.array([diag_main, diag_anti])","path":"solution.py"}
